title: 🔥 Chirag games on a soft bed... the thermal throttling nobody checks #laptop #cooling
title_alts: 🔥 Chirag's laptop clocks drop on fabric... how thermal throttling works #laptop #cooling
🔥 Chirag lifts the laptop's back edge... the cooling mistake to avoid #laptop #cooling
description_hook: A laptop on a duvet is a laptop with its lungs covered. Here is what the chip does about it, and the small gap of air that fixes it.
setting: a dim bedroom and a plain wooden desk
protagonist_type: a student gaming on a thin laptop

characters.name: Chirag
characters.description: nineteen, short black hair, grey hoodie, a cracked phone case he never replaces

claims.claim: Above roughly ninety-five degrees, the chip lowers its own clock speed.
claims.basis: typical laptop processor thermal limit, stated as approximate in the narration

claims.claim: Say a chip holds four gigahertz on a desk.
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: On a quilt it settles near two point four.
claims.basis: round illustrative throttled clock figure, offered as an example

claims.claim: Two centimetres of clear air under the intake changes the whole session.
claims.basis: round illustrative clearance, not a measured threshold

scenes.narration: A soft bed can cut your laptop's speed in half.
scenes.caption: नरम बिस्तर पर लैपटॉप की रफ़्तार आधी रह सकती है।
scenes.image_brief: A thin silver laptop half sunk into a rumpled blue duvet on an unmade bed, its rear edge pressed down into the fabric, in a dark bedroom lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: Laptop fans pull cool air through slots underneath the chassis.
scenes.caption: लैपटॉप का फ़ैन नीचे बनी झिरियों से ठंडी हवा खींचता है।
scenes.image_brief: The underside of a closed laptop resting upside down on a wooden desk, showing long ventilation slots and four rubber feet, in warm afternoon window light.

scenes.narration: A duvet seals those slots shut. The fan spins into nothing.
scenes.caption: रजाई इन झिरियों को बंद कर देती है। फ़ैन खाली घूमता रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: Thick quilted bedding pushed up against the ventilation slots of a laptop's underside, the fabric bulging into the openings, in soft dim bedroom light.

scenes.narration: You will know why a hard surface buys free performance.
scenes.caption: समझ आएगा कि सख़्त सतह मुफ़्त में रफ़्तार क्यों देती है।
scenes.image_brief: The same silver laptop open on a bare wooden table with clear space beneath it and a visible gap of air under the rear edge, in bright even daylight.

scenes.narration: Hot silicon protects itself. Above roughly ninety-five degrees, the chip lowers its own clock speed.
scenes.caption: गरम चिप ख़ुद को बचाती है। करीब पंचानबे डिग्री पर वह अपनी स्पीड घटा देती है।
scenes.image_brief: An opened laptop with its bottom panel removed on a workbench, bare copper heat pipes and the square processor die visible, under cool white bench light.

scenes.narration: Less airflow means heat stays inside. So clocks keep dropping.
scenes.caption: हवा कम मिले तो गर्मी अंदर ही रहती है। इसलिए स्पीड गिरती जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A warm metal laptop chassis pressed into flattened bedding with no gap beneath it, the quilt creased tightly around all four sides, in dim bedroom light.

scenes.narration: Say a chip holds four gigahertz on a desk.
scenes.caption: मान लें कि मेज़ पर चिप चार गीगाहर्ट्ज़ पर चलती है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen on a wooden desk showing a simple monitoring graph with a flat high line labelled four gigahertz, a desk lamp glowing behind it.

scenes.narration: On a quilt it settles near two point four. Same file, twice the wait.
scenes.caption: रजाई पर वही चिप दो दशमलव चार पर आ जाती है। वही काम, दोगुना इंतज़ार।
scenes.image_brief: The same laptop on bedding, its screen showing the monitoring graph sagging to a low line labelled two point four gigahertz, in dim bedroom light.

scenes.narration: Careful. Dust is the other half of this story.
scenes.caption: सावधान। धूल इस कहानी का दूसरा आधा हिस्सा है।
scenes.image_brief: A grey mat of dust packed across the thin aluminium fins of a laptop heatsink beside its small fan, inside an opened chassis under bright bench light.

scenes.narration: A clogged heatsink throttles on any table. Blocked vents just arrive faster.
scenes.caption: जाम हीटसिंक किसी भी मेज़ पर स्पीड घटाता है। बंद झिरियाँ यह जल्दी करती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A clean laptop heatsink and a dust clogged one lying side by side on a white cloth on a desk, the difference in their fins clearly visible, in even daylight.

scenes.narration: Cooling is not a luxury upgrade. It is performance you already paid for.
scenes.caption: कूलिंग कोई शौक़ का अपग्रेड नहीं है। यह रफ़्तार आपने ख़रीद ली है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop sitting on a simple folding metal stand on a desk with clear open air beneath it and a notebook pushed aside, in calm morning light.

scenes.narration: Two centimetres of clear air under the intake changes the whole session.
scenes.caption: इनटेक के नीचे दो सेंटीमीटर खुली हवा पूरा सेशन बदल देती है।
scenes.image_brief: The rear edge of a laptop propped up on two stacked book spines on a desk, a finger wide gap of air underneath, warm lamp light from one side.

scenes.narration: Tonight, lift the back edge and feel the exhaust.
scenes.caption: आज रात पिछला किनारा उठाकर निकलती गरम हवा महसूस करें।
scenes.image_brief: Air leaving the side vent of a raised laptop on a desk as faint visible haze, a glass of water beside it, in dim evening light.

title: 🧩 Vedika added one big RAM stick... the dual channel slot she missed #ram #dualchannel
title_alts: 🧩 Vedika's two small sticks beat one big one... how dual channel works #ram #memory
🧩 Vedika fills the second memory slot... the upgrade mistake to skip #ram #memory
description_hook: One memory stick uses half the lanes to the processor. Here is why two smaller sticks often feel faster than one large one.
protagonist_type: a designer upgrading her own laptop

characters.name: Vedika
characters.description: twenty-six, long hair tied back, olive green shirt, a small screwdriver tucked behind her ear

claims.claim: One sixteen gigabyte stick gives about twenty-five gigabytes per second.
claims.basis: round illustrative single channel bandwidth, stated as approximate in the narration

claims.claim: Two eight gigabyte sticks push near fifty.
claims.basis: follows from doubling the illustrative single channel figure just stated

claims.claim: If your work needs thirty-two gigabytes, one big stick beats constant swapping.
claims.basis: round illustrative capacity example, not a measured requirement

scenes.narration: Two small memory sticks can beat one big stick.
scenes.caption: दो छोटी मेमोरी स्टिक एक बड़ी स्टिक से आगे निकल सकती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two small green memory sticks lying beside one larger memory stick on a grey anti static mat on a repair bench, under cool even light from above.

scenes.narration: Laptop memory talks to the processor over parallel lanes.
scenes.caption: लैपटॉप की मेमोरी प्रोसेसर से कई समांतर लेन पर बात करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop motherboard on a bench with fine copper traces running in dense parallel lines from the processor area toward two memory slots, in bright bench light.

scenes.narration: One stick uses half those lanes. The other half sits idle, doing nothing.
scenes.caption: एक स्टिक आधी लेन ही लेती है। बाकी आधी लेन खाली बैठी रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Two memory slots inside an opened laptop, one holding a seated stick and the other completely empty with its metal clips still open, in cool white light.

scenes.narration: You will know which slot to fill, and why.
scenes.caption: पता चलेगा कि कौन सा स्लॉट भरना है, और क्यों।
scenes.image_brief: Two memory slots on a laptop board seen from directly above, a memory stick resting on the mat beside the empty second slot, in even daylight.

scenes.narration: Dual channel opens two paths at once. Bandwidth roughly doubles.
scenes.caption: ड्यूअल चैनल दो रास्ते एक साथ खोलता है। बैंडविड्थ लगभग दोगुनी हो जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Both memory slots on a laptop board filled with matching sticks pressed flat and clipped down, their gold contacts hidden, in bright bench light.

scenes.narration: Integrated graphics have no memory of their own. They starve first.
scenes.caption: इंटीग्रेटेड ग्राफ़िक्स की अपनी मेमोरी नहीं होती। वह सबसे पहले तरसती है।
scenes.image_brief: A processor package on a laptop board with no separate graphics chip anywhere near it, only the two memory slots alongside, under cool bench light.

scenes.narration: One sixteen gigabyte stick gives about twenty-five gigabytes per second.
scenes.caption: एक सोलह गीगाबाइट स्टिक करीब पच्चीस गीगाबाइट प्रति सेकंड देती है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a plain memory benchmark reading about twenty-five gigabytes per second, the opened laptop base beside it on a bench, in cool light.

scenes.narration: Two eight gigabyte sticks push near fifty. Games feel the difference.
scenes.caption: दो आठ गीगाबाइट स्टिक करीब पचास तक पहुँचती हैं। गेम में फ़र्क़ दिखता है।
scenes.image_brief: The same laptop screen showing the memory benchmark near fifty gigabytes per second, both memory slots filled and visible in the open chassis, in cool light.

scenes.narration: But size still wins sometimes.
scenes.caption: लेकिन कभी कभी क्षमता ही जीतती है।
scenes.image_brief: One single large capacity memory stick standing upright in a clear plastic tray on a bench, the second tray slot empty beside it, in plain daylight.

scenes.narration: If your work needs thirty-two gigabytes, one big stick beats constant swapping.
scenes.caption: अगर काम को बत्तीस गीगाबाइट चाहिए, तो बड़ी स्टिक बेहतर है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen filled with a memory usage meter pushed almost to the top while the drive activity light glows steadily on the chassis, in dim room light.

scenes.narration: The real question is not how much memory you have. It is how many lanes carry it.
scenes.caption: असल सवाल यह नहीं कि मेमोरी कितनी है। सवाल यह है कि लेन कितनी हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two matching memory sticks seated in both slots of an open laptop with the bottom panel resting to one side and a screwdriver on the mat, in even light.

scenes.narration: Check your memory tab tonight: slots used, one of two.
scenes.caption: आज रात मेमोरी टैब देखें: स्लॉट इस्तेमाल, दो में से एक।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a system memory panel where one line reads slots used one of two, the dark desk around it lit only by the screen.

title: 💾 Pranav's laptop crawls on a full SSD... the free space nobody leaves #ssd #storage
title_alts: 💾 Pranav watches a copy stall... how SSD free space sets write speed #ssd #storage
💾 Pranav clears his crowded SSD... the storage mistake that slows saves #ssd #storage
description_hook: An SSD needs empty blocks to write quickly. Fill the last tenth and every save turns into housekeeping.
problem_domain: solid state storage and write speed
setting: a shared flat with one ageing laptop
protagonist_type: an editor who never deletes footage

characters.name: Pranav
characters.description: thirty-one, thick beard, faded maroon t-shirt, reading glasses pushed up on his forehead

claims.claim: Say a drive sits at ninety-eight percent full.
claims.basis: round illustrative fill level, stated as an assumption in the narration

claims.claim: Copying a four gigabyte folder can take minutes, not seconds.
claims.basis: round illustrative comparison for a nearly full drive, offered as an example

claims.claim: So keep roughly a tenth of the drive empty.
claims.basis: common rule of thumb for spare area, stated as approximate

scenes.narration: A full SSD writes far slower than a half empty one.
scenes.caption: भरी हुई एसएसडी आधी खाली ड्राइव से बहुत धीमे लिखती है।
scenes.image_brief: A small black solid state drive lying on a desk beside a laptop whose screen shows a storage bar filled almost end to end in red, in cool desk light.

scenes.narration: Every save, update and download asks the drive for empty blocks.
scenes.caption: हर सेव, अपडेट और डाउनलोड ड्राइव से खाली ब्लॉक माँगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen with three progress bars stacked in a download window, a file save dialog open behind them, the room dark apart from the screen.

scenes.narration: When those blocks run out, the drive starts clearing space first.
scenes.caption: जब ब्लॉक ख़त्म हो जाएँ, ड्राइव पहले जगह ख़ाली करने लगती है।
scenes.image_brief: A grid of small squares drawn on a laptop screen where nearly every square is shaded and only a few remain blank, in dim room light.

scenes.narration: You will know how much room to keep spare.
scenes.caption: पता चलेगा कि कितनी जगह ख़ाली रखनी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A storage settings page on a laptop screen with a long bar and a small pale section of free space at its end, the laptop on a cluttered desk.

scenes.narration: Flash cannot overwrite. It erases a whole block, then rewrites what it kept.
scenes.caption: फ़्लैश ऊपर से नहीं लिखती। वह पूरा ब्लॉक मिटाकर बचा डेटा फिर लिखती है।
scenes.image_brief: An exposed solid state drive circuit board on a bench with four flash memory chips and a controller chip visible, under bright even bench light.

scenes.narration: With little free space, one small save can trigger a lot of shuffling.
scenes.caption: जगह कम हो तो एक छोटा सेव भी बहुत फेरबदल करा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a file copy window stuck at a low percentage with the estimated time climbing, the drive activity light glowing on the chassis.

scenes.narration: Say a drive sits at ninety-eight percent full. Copying a four gigabyte folder can take minutes, not seconds.
scenes.caption: मान लें ड्राइव अट्ठानबे प्रतिशत भरी है। चार गीगाबाइट कॉपी करने में मिनट लगते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a nearly full storage bar above a slow copy dialog for a four gigabyte video folder, a mug of cold tea beside the laptop.

scenes.narration: Deleting files is not always enough.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइलें मिटाना हमेशा काफ़ी नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: An open recycle bin window on a laptop screen holding many large video files, the storage bar behind it still almost completely full, in cool light.

scenes.narration: Space held by old restore points and temporary files still counts as used.
scenes.caption: पुराने रिस्टोर पॉइंट और टेम्परेरी फ़ाइलों की जगह भी भरी ही गिनी जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A disk cleanup style list on a laptop screen with large sizes shown next to temporary files and system restore entries, the desk dark around it.

scenes.narration: So keep roughly a tenth of the drive empty. The speed comes back.
scenes.caption: इसलिए ड्राइव का करीब दसवाँ हिस्सा ख़ाली रखें। रफ़्तार लौट आती है।
scenes.image_brief: A storage bar on a laptop screen with a clear tenth left pale and empty at the end, a fast copy dialog finishing beside it, in bright morning light.

scenes.narration: Open your storage settings and read the free space number.
scenes.caption: स्टोरेज सेटिंग खोलें और ख़ाली जगह का आँकड़ा पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a wooden table showing the storage settings page with the free space figure at the top of the panel, in soft daylight from a window.

title: 🔋 Meenal leaves her laptop plugged in... the charge limit nobody sets #battery #batteryhealth
title_alts: 🔋 Meenal's battery holds less each month... how charge level ages cells #battery #batteryhealth
🔋 Meenal caps her charging at eighty... the battery habit to drop #battery #batteryhealth
description_hook: A laptop battery does not mind being used. It minds sitting full and warm for months. Here is the setting that changes that.
setting: a home office desk with a permanent charger

characters.name: Meenal
characters.description: forty-two, greying bob, navy cardigan, a beaded lanyard of keys on the desk

claims.claim: Say a pack sits at a hundred percent, warm, every working day.
claims.basis: round illustrative usage pattern, stated as an assumption in the narration

claims.claim: A year later it might hold only four fifths of its old charge.
claims.basis: round illustrative capacity loss, offered as an example not a measurement

claims.claim: So on desk days, cap the charge near eighty percent.
claims.basis: common charge limit offered by laptop makers, stated as approximate

scenes.narration: A battery ages fastest while sitting at full charge.
scenes.caption: बैटरी सबसे तेज़ी से पूरी चार्ज हालत में बैठे-बैठे बूढ़ी होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk showing a full battery icon with the charger cable plugged in and coiled, a thin layer of dust on the power brick, in warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Every laptop battery is a stack of lithium cells in a sealed pack.
scenes.caption: हर लैपटॉप बैटरी सीलबंद पैक में लिथियम सेल का ढेर होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A flat laptop battery pack removed from its chassis and resting on a bench, its three soft pouch cells and ribbon connector visible, in cool bench light.

scenes.narration: A full cell sits at its highest voltage. That voltage wears it down.
scenes.caption: पूरा सेल सबसे ऊँचे वोल्टेज पर रहता है। वही वोल्टेज उसे घिसता है।
scenes.image_brief: A multimeter resting on a bench with its probes touching a battery pack's contacts and a high voltage reading on its display, under bright bench light.

scenes.narration: You will know the two habits that slow that wear.
scenes.caption: पता चलेगा कि कौन सी दो आदतें यह घिसाव धीमा करती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a battery settings panel with a charge limit slider and a plain battery health figure, the laptop on a tidy home office desk.

scenes.narration: Heat and high voltage speed up the chemistry inside a cell.
scenes.caption: गर्मी और ऊँचा वोल्टेज सेल के अंदर की केमिस्ट्री तेज़ कर देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A warm laptop underside with the battery area visibly hotter, resting on a desk beside a closed charger brick, in low evening room light.

scenes.narration: Thin films grow on the electrodes. Usable capacity quietly shrinks.
scenes.caption: इलेक्ट्रोड पर पतली परतें जमती हैं। काम की क्षमता चुपचाप घटती है।
scenes.image_brief: A slightly swollen pouch cell lying beside a flat healthy one on a white bench mat, the difference in thickness clear, under even overhead light.

scenes.narration: Say a pack sits at a hundred percent, warm, every working day.
scenes.caption: मान लें पैक हर दिन सौ प्रतिशत पर, गरम हालत में रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk with its battery icon at full and the charger plugged in, morning sun falling directly across the closed lid and the cable.

scenes.narration: A year later it might hold only four fifths of its old charge.
scenes.caption: साल भर बाद उसमें पुरानी क्षमता का करीब अस्सी प्रतिशत बचे।
scenes.image_brief: A battery report on a laptop screen with a design capacity line above a smaller full charge capacity line, the desk quiet and dim around it.

scenes.narration: But do not obsess.
scenes.caption: लेकिन ज़्यादा चिंता न करें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop closed on a packed travel bag beside a passport and a charger, the charger cable plugged into a wall socket nearby, in plain daylight.

scenes.narration: Charging to full before a long journey costs you almost nothing.
scenes.caption: लंबे सफ़र से पहले पूरा चार्ज करने से लगभग कोई नुक़सान नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop charging at an airport style waiting seat with a full battery icon on screen and the cable running to a floor socket, in bright terminal light.

scenes.narration: The damage comes from staying full, not from reaching full.
scenes.caption: नुक़सान पूरा चार्ज रहने से होता है, पूरा चार्ज करने से नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A battery icon on a laptop screen held at a partial level with the charger plugged in and a small paused charging symbol beside it, in soft desk light.

scenes.narration: So on desk days, cap the charge near eighty percent.
scenes.caption: इसलिए मेज़ के दिनों में चार्ज करीब अस्सी प्रतिशत पर रोकें।
scenes.image_brief: A settings panel on a laptop screen with a charge limit slider pulled to eighty percent, the laptop sitting on a clean desk beside a notebook.

scenes.narration: Open your laptop maker's battery app and find that limit.
scenes.caption: आज ही अपने लैपटॉप निर्माता की बैटरी एप में वह लिमिट देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a manufacturer battery utility with a battery care option highlighted in its list, the room lit only by the display.

title: 🎮 Ishaan's new graphics card does nothing... the port behind the case #gpu #pcbuild
title_alts: 🎮 Ishaan moves the display cable down... how a graphics card takes over #gpu #pcbuild
🎮 Ishaan checks his monitor cable... the port mistake after a build #gpu #pcbuild
description_hook: A graphics card can only draw what the cable asks it to draw. Plug into the wrong row of ports and the card never joins in.
problem_domain: desktop graphics output and display ports
setting: a bedroom corner with a first self built tower

characters.name: Ishaan
characters.description: seventeen, buzz cut, oversized football jersey, a thin steel bracelet on one wrist

claims.claim: Say a game manages thirty frames a second on the motherboard port.
claims.basis: round illustrative frame rate for integrated graphics, stated as an assumption

claims.claim: Move the cable down to the card. The same scene reaches ninety.
claims.basis: round illustrative comparison figure, offered as an example not a benchmark

scenes.narration: A new graphics card can sit unused all year.
scenes.caption: नया ग्राफ़िक्स कार्ड पूरे साल बेकार पड़ा रह सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A large graphics card seated in a desktop tower behind a glass side panel, its fans still and dust settling on the shroud, in dim bedroom light.

scenes.narration: Most desktop towers have two separate sets of video ports.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर डेस्कटॉप टावर में वीडियो पोर्ट के दो अलग सेट होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The rear of a desktop tower showing a cluster of ports high on the motherboard panel and a separate row of ports lower down, under bright work light.

scenes.narration: One set belongs to the motherboard. The other belongs to the card itself.
scenes.caption: एक सेट मदरबोर्ड का है। दूसरा ख़ुद ग्राफ़िक्स कार्ड का।
scenes.image_brief: A close view of a tower's back panel where the upper motherboard video connectors and the lower graphics card connectors sit apart, in even light.

scenes.narration: Which row of ports should the cable go into?
scenes.caption: केबल पोर्ट की किस पंक्ति में लगनी चाहिए?
scenes.image_brief: A single display cable hanging loose behind a desktop tower with both rows of video ports empty and visible, the floor around the tower bare.

scenes.narration: The motherboard ports are wired to the graphics engine inside the processor.
scenes.caption: मदरबोर्ड के पोर्ट प्रोसेसर के अंदर बैठे ग्राफ़िक्स इंजन से जुड़े होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An open desktop case laid on its side showing short board traces running from the processor socket area to the motherboard video connectors, in bench light.

scenes.narration: Plug in there and your expensive card never draws a single frame.
scenes.caption: वहाँ लगाया तो महँगा कार्ड एक फ़्रेम भी नहीं बनाता।
scenes.image_brief: A display cable plugged into the upper motherboard port while the graphics card's own ports below sit empty with dust caps on, in cool room light.

scenes.narration: Say a game manages thirty frames a second on the motherboard port.
scenes.caption: मान लें मदरबोर्ड पोर्ट पर गेम तीस फ़्रेम प्रति सेकंड देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a game scene with a small frame rate counter in the corner reading thirty, the desktop tower beside it, in dim evening light.

scenes.narration: Move the cable down to the card. The same scene reaches ninety.
scenes.caption: केबल नीचे कार्ड पर लगाएँ। वही दृश्य नब्बे तक पहुँच जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: The same monitor showing the same game scene with the frame rate counter now reading ninety, the cable running to the lower card port, in dim light.

scenes.narration: Laptops work the other way.
scenes.caption: लैपटॉप में मामला उलटा है।
scenes.image_brief: An open laptop on a desk with its own screen lit and no external cables attached, the hinge and rear vents plainly visible, in soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Their built in screen is wired through the processor on purpose.
scenes.caption: उनकी अपनी स्क्रीन जान-बूझकर प्रोसेसर से होकर जुड़ी होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop opened for repair on a bench with the flat display ribbon cable running from the screen hinge to the main board, under bright bench light.

scenes.narration: So the card was never slow. It was simply not in the path.
scenes.caption: तो कार्ड कभी धीमा नहीं था। वह रास्ते में ही नहीं था।
scenes.image_brief: A graphics card lifted out of a tower and resting on the desk beside the open case, its connectors facing the viewer, in bright even light.

scenes.narration: A cable, not a setting, decides which chip does the work.
scenes.caption: कौन सी चिप काम करेगी, यह केबल तय करती है, सेटिंग नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A display cable firmly seated in the lower graphics card port of a tower, the upper motherboard ports empty above it, in clear work light.

scenes.narration: Look behind your tower: are the ports high or low?
scenes.caption: अपने टावर के पीछे देखें: पोर्ट ऊपर हैं या नीचे?
scenes.image_brief: The back of a desktop tower under a desk with a torch beam picking out the two rows of video ports and the cable already plugged into one.

title: 🔌 Gaurav runs his laptop on a small USB-C charger... the wattage trap #usbc #charging
title_alts: 🔌 Gaurav's battery falls while charging... how USB-C wattage is agreed #usbc #charging
🔌 Gaurav reads the print on the brick... the charger mistake to avoid #usbc #charging
description_hook: A laptop can lose charge with the cable still in. The number that explains it is printed on the brick in tiny type.
setting: a cafe table and a cramped desk

characters.name: Gaurav
characters.description: thirty-five, shaved head, denim jacket, a canvas sling bag he never puts down

claims.claim: Say the laptop pulls sixty-five watts while it exports a video.
claims.basis: round illustrative load figure, stated as an assumption in the narration

claims.claim: A thirty watt brick supplies less than half.
claims.basis: arithmetic from the sixty-five watt load and thirty watt supply already stated

scenes.narration: A small charger can drain your laptop while plugged in.
scenes.caption: छोटा चार्जर प्लग लगे रहने पर भी लैपटॉप की बैटरी घटा सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a cafe table with a tiny white charger plugged into its side and a battery icon showing a falling level, in warm window light.

scenes.narration: USB-C chargers and laptops negotiate before any power flows.
scenes.caption: यूएसबी-सी चार्जर और लैपटॉप बिजली देने से पहले बातचीत करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A USB-C plug held just short of a laptop's port, the small oval connector and the socket both clearly in view, on a wooden cafe table in daylight.

scenes.narration: They agree on a voltage and a current limit. Multiply those and you get watts.
scenes.caption: वे वोल्टेज और करंट की सीमा तय करते हैं। दोनों का गुणा वाट है।
scenes.image_brief: The underside of a charger brick on a table with its printed specification block of voltages and currents facing up, in bright even light.

scenes.narration: Which number on the brick actually matters?
scenes.caption: ब्रिक पर लिखा कौन सा आँकड़ा असल में मायने रखता है?
scenes.image_brief: Two charger bricks side by side on a desk, one small and one noticeably larger, their printed labels turned toward the viewer, in cool desk light.

scenes.narration: Under heavy load the whole system asks for more than a small brick can give.
scenes.caption: भारी काम में पूरा सिस्टम छोटे ब्रिक से ज़्यादा बिजली माँगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk with a video export progress bar on screen, its fans audible and the small charger plugged in at the side, in dim room light.

scenes.narration: The shortfall comes out of the battery. The percentage falls as you work.
scenes.caption: कमी बैटरी से पूरी होती है। काम करते-करते प्रतिशत गिरता है।
scenes.image_brief: A battery indicator on a laptop screen showing a lower level than before with a charging symbol still present, the room lit only by the display.

scenes.narration: Say the laptop pulls sixty-five watts while it exports a video.
scenes.caption: मान लें वीडियो एक्सपोर्ट करते समय लैपटॉप पैंसठ वाट खींचता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small power meter plugged in between a wall socket and a laptop charger, its display reading sixty-five watts, in plain daylight near a desk.

scenes.narration: A thirty watt brick supplies less than half. The rest leaves the battery.
scenes.caption: तीस वाट का ब्रिक आधे से कम देता है। बाकी बैटरी से जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small charger brick labelled thirty watts lying beside a laptop whose screen shows a battery level below half, in warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Light work is different. For mail and documents, a small brick charges the machine fine.
scenes.caption: हल्का काम अलग बात है। मेल और दस्तावेज़ के लिए छोटा ब्रिक ठीक चार्ज करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a train tray table showing a plain document page, the small charger plugged in and the battery icon climbing, in flat overcast light.

scenes.narration: So the charger is not weak. It is weak for that job.
scenes.caption: तो चार्जर कमज़ोर नहीं है। वह उस काम के लिए कमज़ोर है।
scenes.image_brief: The small charger and a larger charger lying on a desk on either side of a laptop, cables coiled loosely, in even overhead light.

scenes.narration: Match the wattage to the heaviest thing you actually ask it to do.
scenes.caption: वाट उस सबसे भारी काम के हिसाब से चुनें जो आप असल में करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A larger charger brick plugged into a laptop that is exporting video, the battery icon holding steady at a high level, in cool evening room light.

scenes.narration: Read the small print on your brick: watts, not just volts.
scenes.caption: अपने ब्रिक की महीन लिखावट पढ़ें: वाट, सिर्फ़ वोल्ट नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A charger brick turned label side up on a desk under a bright lamp, its tiny printed output line legible, a laptop cable beside it.
